Name: Seasonal Morris Tod
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Mod Basics﻿[/center][/size][/b]So here's the thing.  Vanilla Morris has a ghost in his coat.  I [i]hate[/i] that coat ghost.  I was perfectly happy with SCC Morris until I realized I would kinda like to actually do a Joja run at some point in my life just to see it.  But then I realized I could also do my Joja run with Marry Morris!  Two birds, one stone and all that!  And that's when the whole coat ghost thing started absolutely slapping me in the face.  So in true [i]me[/i] fashion, the only answer to that sort of issue... Was to just go ahead and make a new Portrait and sprite for Morris.  And since I don't keep that stuff to myself?  Here ya go.

[b][size=5][center]Installing and Use[/center][/size][/b]
1. Unzip
2. Drop it in the mods folder
3. Profit!  It's just that easy!

[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center][b]Seasonal cute Characters (regular and SVE):[/b]  You'll need to turn off Morris/Morris Tod in the configs, be that manually or with GMCM, but that will fix it.
[b]Marry Morris:[/b] You will need to be sure that my mod is below MM so the kissing sprites work correctly. if you're not using folders, this will happen naturally.
[b]Morris Redeemed:[/b]  Fully compatible.  No notes.  Love the way they made this mod.
[b]PolyamorySweet:[/b] You will need to add Morris;41 and MorrisTod:41 to the "CustomKissFrames" in the config for PolyamorySweetKiss or when you try to kiss Morris he will touch his glasses.  I'm looking into making a mod so the code shy won't have to mess with it but there's no documentation I can find on making a pack for Poly's kiss mod.
[b]Other:[/b] I have not tested extensively because I haven't played Joja stuff so there may be other issues I'm not yet aware of.

If you run into an issue, please feel free to poke me about it, I will be happy to try and either troubleshoot and or fix it.

[center][size=5][b]Plans for the Future[/b][/size][/center]
I don't have much in the way of things I've considered, but a few things have crossed my mind:
[list]
[*][b]Luau outfit: [/b] Because K'mon, he'd totally wear an offensively bright and colorful shirt to something like that.
[*][b]Other festivals:[/b] I know he's gonna show up in more of them in MM.  I'm just not sure what he'll be wearing though.
[*][b]Config File:[/b]  I don't have anything to config right now but I feel like I will if I add more stuff...
[*][b]Suggestions:[/b] I will take them!
[/list]
[center][b][size=5]The Other Stuff[/size][/b][/center][size=3]Notes:[/size][b] [/b]From how Morris acts I kinda feel like he wouldn't have the time to change his outfit on a day where he would be doing something like going to a festival... So I have him in his flower dance outfit all that day.  So that's not a mistake?
[size=3][b]Support[/b][/size] is possible through my [url=http://ko-fi.com/lynn_nexus]Kofi[/url]
And last but not least: I only post on Nexus.  If you see my art or mods elsewhere?  Feel free to name and shame the thief.
